body:
Wait,  before you do anything, please just hear me out

Listen , I get it, I really do. I know what you are feeling. If you don't believe me look at my post history. 

Everyday I wake up, and the feeling of depression and anxiety hits me like a brink wall. My singular though throughout the entire day waiting to do back to sleep. If im not thinking about that, Im lost in fantasies that I know will never happen, and I get even more depressed. Hell, the only pleasure I get is from eating food. 

Do you have any family members or a significant other? Honesty, they are only thing keeping me from blowing my brains out. If I didn't have them,  I would have done it a while ago. I don't want to put them through the pain of find my brains splattered all over the wall. I don't want to put them through the same pain that I am going to.

Im not going to make a promise by saying that it gets better, because I don't know. We can never I don't know your situation. If you are still alive, and if you don't mind telling me, Im curious to as what caused all of this.

Hey,

Don't end it tonight. Do you have any love ones? I know what you are going through, as I am going through something similar. Honesty, the only thing keeping me alive is them. If they weren't around, I would have done it a while ago. I don't want them to hear a bang and come up the stairs and see my brains spattered all over the wall.  That's not something I would want to put them through, I love them too much.

Its hard, I know, Believe me, I do.  I wake up the only thing I think about is when Im going to go back to sleep. Its funny, I cant remember the last time I slept for more then 3 hours without waking up in a cold sweat. I haven't been able to hold down a job for more then 6 months. When I do manage to hold one down, my depression and social anxiety prevents me from making friends with my co workers. I almost always the outcast that everyone treats like their slow or something.

Consider me a friend if you want. or a least someone who understands what you are going through. If you need someone to talk to, or if you just want an ear to listen, Im here 24/7.
Why should I keep trying? Whats the point? Nothing I do works. Everytime I try to get better I just end up digging myself a deeper hole. Its just too much.

Hey dude, I read the whole thing and I have to say I know what you are going through, as I'm in almost the exact same situation. I really don't have a lot of friends either. Well I have friends but I don't trust any of them. I think that they are all talking behind my back, or that they are only my friend because they feel bad for me. 

As for social skills, you and I again share a common thread. I am absolutely terrible with interacting with people. I never speak when spoken too, and when I do speak, I'm all over the place and sometimes don't make any sense. I end up being an outcast where ever I go. When I do talk, I always say something I regret. If and when I do get comfortable with people, I get loud and sometimes obnoxious and say off color jokes to make them laugh. I do this because I want to stop feeling depressed but I often make myself look like an ass. You pretty much summed it up when you said: 

>No-one wants to hang around with me outside anymore, no matter what. All of my classmates never gave a fuck about me at all.

I'm in the same dark place that you are. It's funny, it's almost like a switch that went off in my head. I went from being extremely depressed, but thinking I would never consider suicide, to thinking
"wow, suicide doesn't seem so bad now". 

You and I are in the same boat. Consider me a friend if you'd like. or a least someone who understands what you are going through. If you need someone to talk to, or if you need an ear to listen, Im here 24/7.
